scope: native contract and logical ownership; no authoritative fencing, SunFS mount, concurrent SMP or physical durability qualification
runner_seed_label: 0x5b1001 is a fixed scenario label, not a PRNG input
fault_seed: none: deterministic injected tuples and explicit boundary cases

fields.device.incarnation: global AtomicU64 checked allocation, attachment-local authority; refusal at exhaustion
fields.queue_incarnation: one immutable queue epoch 1 per fresh device incarnation; no reinitialize API
fields.generation: checked sequence also ownership epoch and submission order; max is refused before publication
fields.head: owned descriptor head; checked against used ring; same head reused only after valid completion

logical_token_checks: Owner::complete matches exact active ID, device, queue, Submitted state and resource validation
wire_limit: legacy used entry carries head and length only. Forged old completion after slot reuse can alias the current request; executable regression demonstrates acceptance. No claim of wire generation authentication.
wrapping: u16 ring indices wrap as protocol indices only; u64 identity counters never wrap
requalification: reset/media replacement requires external proven quiescence and new attachment identity; unavailable here
